correctness.rationale: A family can be normalized so a selected word is 0000 via independent ternary symbol permutations. Independently reconstructed all 80 other words and exact 3-word separation predicates; branch-and-bound over every normalized compatible set visited 18,705 bound nodes and found maximum 9; separate cardinality-9 enumeration found exactly 8 normalized maxima. For all 8, every coordinate-pair projection is bijective (OA), and independent full 6^4*4!=31,104 group enumeration of a representative produced exactly 72 arrays with eight containing 0000; hence complete and one orbit, stabilizer 432. Conversely OA entails PHF by no pair agreeing twice among four rows. Finite exhaustive proof with explicit search invariant, not extrapolation.
